notes.title: Next Alfred update coming soon: Matchmaking and more
notes.notes:
Hello there pawns!

This week just a small note to keep you guys updated on what we are working on right now.

First of all, Alfred next update is scheduled to release next week on Friday!

As requested, you will soon be able to open public lobbys, allowing unknow players to join you if they whishes. Rest assured, you will still be able to create private lobbys to play only with people that you know.
We apologize for not bringing this feature sooner, but we had some technical difficulties and decided to launch without it.
This feature is still being tested as we speak and will normally be released with the next week update.

Also, it came to our attention that players with screen resolutions above 1920x1080 experienced problems. We currently working on it and some fixes will be provided in the next week update. Comming with thoses fixes, the settings menu will allow you to chose smaller resolution in "Windowed" mode (At first only 1920x1080 & 1280x720 will be available). Please continue to keep us updated if you are facing any issues.

We have a few more things comming in the next week update, and we can't wait to tell you more about it next week!

In the mean time, thank you again for playing ALFRED is a BAD GUY, we hope that you are having a good time!

Ivo
